params.body:
## Why

`composer audit --locked` ("Dependencies carry no new advisory") fails on every pull request since seven Symfony advisories were published on 25 November 2026:

| Package | CVE |
|---|---|
| symfony/http-kernel | CVE-2026-133743 |
| symfony/mailer | CVE-2026-133751, CVE-2026-133755 |
| symfony/routing | CVE-2026-133746, CVE-2026-133754 |
| symfony/serializer | CVE-2026-133752, CVE-2026-133761 |

All are fixed in 8.1.12.

## What changes

Only `composer.lock`. These patch releases go to 8.1.12: http-kernel, http-foundation (http-kernel 8.1.12 requires it), mailer, routing and serializer, from 8.1.10/8.1.11. Nothing else moves.

## Checked

`composer audit --locked`: no advisories. Full suite: 3332 green.

Merge this first: #1131 and its replacement fail the audit job until this is on `main`.
params.title: Symfony 8.1.12 for seven advisories published on 25 November 2026
